fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-03-20, a white motorcycle bearing registration number TN-68-YY-1040 belonging to the complainant was taken from Oviya Colony Railway Station Road in Erode. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-03-20 at approximately 03:10. Contact details given by the complainant, Divya Sekar, include the number 9000000371. A second person, Babu Krishnan (9000000033), was also mentioned as possibly present. Rajesh Chandran (mobile 9000000486) was named as a possible person of interest. Amudha Kannan (9000000066) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Items referenced in the complaint: a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle reportedly taken during the night from a residential parking spot.
